title: path.join, no .. tricks

blocks.promptMd: `path.join` by itself blocks `..` and keeps you inside the folder.
blocks.explainMd: join glues names. You must refuse .. yourself before you open the path.

hintLadder.md: Join the root and the name. Check the name first.
If `name` includes `..`, throw. Do not open that path.

description: Join path parts safely. Do not walk above the folder you meant.
